notes: Kept as drawn: the roof's right slope stops on the chart panel's left edge, which also closes the house on the right (the house's right eave is hidden behind the panel); the walls stop about 4 px below the roof; the chimney is an open outline whose legs stop above the roof and above the panel. The bars rise in unequal steps (9.25, then 11.25 px), as drawn, and are not centred in the panel. The zigzag arrow and its head are the red accent; the panel, bars, house and door are black.
